queries.sql: SELECT courses.*, subjects.code AS subject_code, subjects.name AS subject_name, users.name AS teacher_name, classes.name AS class_name, classes.grade AS class_grade, academic_years.name AS academic_year_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_students WHERE course_students.course_id = courses.id) AS student_count FROM `courses` JOIN `subjects` ON `subjects`.`id` = `courses`.`subject_id` JOIN `teachers` ON `teachers`.`id` = `courses`.`teacher_id` JOIN `users` ON `users`.`id` = `teachers`.`user_id` JOIN `classes` ON `classes`.`id` = `courses`.`class_id` JOIN `academic_years` ON `academic_years`.`id` = `courses`.`academic_year_id` WHERE `courses`.`teacher_id` = 1 ORDER BY `courses`.`title` ASC

SELECT `a`.`course_id`, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_published = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS published FROM `assignments` `a` JOIN `courses` `c` ON `c`.`id` = `a`.`course_id` WHERE `c`.`teacher_id` = 1 GROUP BY `a`.`course_id`

SELECT `q`.`course_id`, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN q.is_published = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS published FROM `quizzes` `q` JOIN `courses` `c` ON `c`.`id` = `q`.`course_id` WHERE `c`.`teacher_id` = 1 GROUP BY `q`.`course_id`
